scope: AOT Release fixture of 192 rounded shapes with changing widths. CPU, PSS and RSS are whole-process metrics.

benchmark.update: Alternate each shape width between 8 and 10 logical units on each app frame callback.
benchmark.androidComparison: Change only the rounded shape call from two separate native dimension modifiers to one Compose size modifier.
benchmark.iosReference: AOT emits a concrete SwiftUI RoundedRectangle, color fill, and single frame. No alternate wrapper is needed for the native baseline.

platforms.ios: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, iOS 27.0; CADisplayLink target 60 Hz
platforms.android: emulator-5554, Android 12 API 31; ART speed compilation after each install; cadence from retained gfxinfo frame records

memoryEndurance.scope: Each platform ran concurrently. Long samples inform memory observations only.

circleGeometry.boundsEncoding: x, y, width, height in arbitrary equal units
circleGeometry.swiftVerification: Native Circle().path(in:).boundingRect measured on the iOS simulator.
circleGeometry.composeVerification: Emitted helper evaluated with Compose 1.12.1 geometry, both directions. Zero-size outline bounds verified separately.
